section: Part II, Chapter 7 — The Intellects and Spheres Are Conscious and Choose
subtitle: דלאלהֵ אלחאירין — The Guide of the Perplexed
author: Moses Maimonides (1138–1204)
intro: The term 'angel' is a homonym covering Intelligences, spheres, and elements alike — all execute divine commands. But the spheres and Intelligences are not like brute natural forces that act blindly: they are conscious of what they do and act with free choice within their appointed sphere of action. Scripture confirms this: the angel tells Lot 'I cannot do anything' and 'I have accepted thee' — language of awareness and discretion. The difference from human free will is that the Intelligences and spheres always act well and never introduce evil or deficiency.

source.edition: Sefaria — version 'Judeo Arabic, Paris, 1856 [jrb]' (the 1856 Paris/Munk Arabic base; public-domain by age)

terms.note: Unlike natural forces, the Intelligences and spheres know what they are doing and choose to do it — a crucial distinction in the theory.
The spheres and Intelligences have willed choice within their assigned domain, analogous to human free will within ours.

terms.gloss: they always perform what is good
terms.note: The moral perfection of the Intelligences: unlike humans who can choose evil, the separated intellects and spheres act only for the good — always and without fail.

aligned.en: Part Two · Chapter Seven — The Intellects and Spheres Are Conscious and Choose

aligned.ja: קד בינא אשתראך אסם מלאך ואנה יעם אלעקול ואלאפלאך ואלאסטקסאת לאן כלהא מנפד׳הֵ אמר. לכן לא תט׳ן אן אלאפלאך או אלעקול במנזלהֵ סאיר אלקוי אלג׳סמאניה אלתי הי טביעה ולא תדרך פעלהא בל אלאפלאך ואלעקול מדרכה אפעאלהא ומכ׳תארה ומדברה לכן ליס מת׳ל אכ׳תיארנא ולא תדבירנא אלד׳י הו כלה באמור מתג׳דדה. קד נצת אלתורה במעאני נבהתנא עלי ד׳לך קאל אלמלאך ללוט כי לא אוכל לעשות דבר וגו׳ וקאל לה לתכ׳ליצה הנה נשאתי פניך גם לדבר הזה וקאל השמר מפניו ושמע בקולו אל תמר בו כי לא ישא לפשעכם כי שמי בקרבו פהד׳ה כלהא תדלך עלי אדראכהם לאפעאלהם וכונהם להם אראדה ואכ׳תיאר פי מא פוץ׳ להם מן אלתדביר כמא לנא אראדה פי מא פוץ׳ לנא ואקדרנא עליה פי אצל כוננא גיר אן נחן קד נפעל אלאנקץ ויתקדם תדבירנא ופעלנא אלאעדאם אמא אלעקול ואלאפלאך פליסת כד׳לך בל תפעל אלכ׳יר אבדא וליס ענדהא אלא אלכ׳יר כמא נבין פי פצול וכל מא להא מוג׳וד באלכמאל ואלפעל דאימא מנד׳ וג׳דת:
aligned.en: WE have already explained that the term "angel" is a homonym, and is used of the intellectual beings, the spheres, and the elements: for all these are engaged in performing a divine command. But do not imagine that the Intelligences and the spheres are like other forces which reside in bodies and act by the laws of nature without being conscious of what they do. The spheres and the Intelligences are conscious of their actions, and select by their own free will the objects of their influence, although not in the same manner as we exercise free will and rule over other things, which only concern temporary beings. I have been led to adopt this theory by certain passages in Scripture: e.g., an angel says to Lot: "For I cannot do anything," etc. (Gen. 19:21); and telling him to deliver himself, the angel says: "Behold I have accepted thee concerning this thing" (ver. 21). Again: "Take heed before him, and listen to his voice," etc. (Exod. 23:21). These passages show that angels are conscious of what they do, and have free will in the sphere of action intrusted to them, just as we have free will within our province, and in accordance with the power given to us with our very existence. The difference is that what we do is the lowest stage of excellence, and that our influence and actions are preceded by non-action; whilst the Intelligences and the spheres always perform that which is good, they contain nothing except what is good and perfect, as will be shown further on, and they have continually been active from the beginning.

pairs.en: do not imagine that the Intelligences and the spheres are like other forces which reside in bodies and act by the laws of nature without being conscious of what they do

pairs.ja: אלאפלאך ואלעקול מדרכה אפעאלהא ומכ׳תארה ומדברה
pairs.en: The spheres and the Intelligences are conscious of their actions, and select by their own free will the objects of their influence

pairs.ja: הנה נשאתי פניך גם לדבר הזה
pairs.en: Behold I have accepted thee concerning this thing

pairs.ja: גיר אן נחן קד נפעל אלאנקץ ויתקדם תדבירנא ופעלנא אלאעדאם
pairs.en: The difference is that what we do is the lowest stage of excellence, and that our influence and actions are preceded by non-action

pairs.ja: אמא אלעקול ואלאפלאך פליסת כד׳לך בל תפעל אלכ׳יר אבדא וליס ענדהא אלא אלכ׳יר
pairs.en: the Intelligences and the spheres always perform that which is good, they contain nothing except what is good and perfect
